summary: Uranus cycle milestones mark phases of individuation, disruption, freedom, reinvention, and changing relationship to the life script.
body: Use Uranus cycle milestones as long-range life-cycle context. The first square, opposition, last square, and return can coincide with changes in freedom, identity, work, community, technology, and the need to stop living inside an inherited pattern. Because Uranus is a modern outer planet, treat this as a modern lens and do not use it in traditional dignity, sect, rulership, or time-lord logic.
definition: Uranus takes about 84 years to return to its natal position, with major quarter-cycle checkpoints around ages 21, 42, 63, and 84.
appUsage: Compute exact Uranus contacts to natal Uranus by degree; do not rely on age alone.
Label this explicitly as a modern outer-planet life-cycle layer.
Use the cycle to contextualize life phases, not to predict sudden events by itself.
Check transits to angles, Sun, Moon, chart ruler, and time-lord context before surfacing event examples.
note: Expanded from approved project outer-planet source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.

cycleFacts.segments: Four roughly 21-year phases: initiation, cultivation, review, adjustment.
cycleFacts.theme: A long story of dissatisfaction with the status quo and learning to value the eccentric, one-of-a-kind self. Upheaval (the Tower) asks you to improvise, innovate, and adapt.

milestones.plainTranslation: First Uranus square. Rebellion, throwing off inherited rules, claiming a life that's your own. Unsettling: you may not know who you are or what you want yet.
milestones.guidance: Experiment and break from what you inherited, but don't burn down everything that works.

milestones.plainTranslation: The Uranus opposition, the classic midlife awakening. Unlike at 21, you know who you are. The question now is whether you still want to be that person. It surfaces every way you don't fit.
milestones.guidance: Make the change you actually need, deliberately, not as a reactive blow-up.

milestones.plainTranslation: The last Uranus square, traditionally the threshold into retirement. New freedom can feel disorienting after a lifetime of structure.
milestones.guidance: Choose how you spend the freedom on purpose. Keep group and community ties; they matter now.

milestones.plainTranslation: The once-in-a-lifetime Uranus return. A final reinvention, and a rejection of society's script for old age.
milestones.guidance: Claim your independence on your own terms.

oppositionMidlife: Restlessness around the life already built, especially when old goals feel abandoned or unexpressed.
A return to school, training, creative practice, or an earlier dream that had been set aside for practical reasons.
A career pivot, leaving a role, exploring self-employment, or changing the structure of work so there is more autonomy.
Relationship reevaluation: changing roles inside the relationship, asking for more freedom, or ending patterns that have gone stagnant.
Impulsive purchases or lifestyle changes as a substitute for the deeper freedom question; treat these as signals, not solutions.
Small controlled changes to routine can discharge the pressure before it becomes a full life overhaul.
constructiveOutlets: Learn something outside the usual lane.
Change a daily routine in a low-risk way before making a major break.
Test a new work format, side project, or independent offer before quitting stable income.
Switch roles in a relationship conversation so each person sees the pattern from the other side.
Use the need for change to update habits, friendships, and thought patterns rather than shocking everyone around you.
cautionExamples: Do not present a new car, breakup, relocation, job exit, or sudden marriage as guaranteed from Uranus alone.
If the user feels urgent pressure to change everything, frame the urgency as information that needs pacing.
Name the difference between freedom and reactivity: freedom creates more agency; reactivity creates cleanup.

transitExamplesByHouse.1: Identity, body, style, and personal direction may feel ready for reinvention; unexpected incidents can force a new self-definition.
transitExamplesByHouse.2: Values, income, possessions, and security patterns may change; the person may need more financial independence or a less conventional resource strategy.
transitExamplesByHouse.3: Mental restlessness rises; new classes, skills, devices, writing, short trips, or sibling/neighborhood changes can become active.
transitExamplesByHouse.4: Home and family patterns get unsettled; repairs, moves, family disruptions, or a desire to change the living environment may surface.
transitExamplesByHouse.5: Romance, dating, creativity, hobbies, and children can become unpredictable; attraction to unusual people or unfamiliar pleasures may increase.
transitExamplesByHouse.6: Daily work, schedules, health habits, and service patterns need flexibility; freelancing, unusual hours, or sudden routine changes can appear.
transitExamplesByHouse.7: Close relationships ask for more room; fast attractions, sudden breaks, renegotiated commitments, or a less conventional partnership model can arise.
transitExamplesByHouse.8: Shared resources, debt, intimacy, trust, and dependency patterns shift; the person may need to stop relying on someone else financially or emotionally.
transitExamplesByHouse.9: Beliefs, travel, education, publishing, and cultural exposure open new doors; interest may spike quickly and need grounding to last.
transitExamplesByHouse.10: Career direction, reputation, and authority relationships can change suddenly; unusual work, public pivots, or self-directed ambition may call louder.
transitExamplesByHouse.11: Friendships, groups, networks, activism, and future plans change; the person may seek more unusual communities or detach from stale circles.
transitExamplesByHouse.12: Old habits, hidden anxieties, retreat, service, and unconscious patterns get interrupted; private liberation work matters before it becomes public.

prohibitions: Do not use Uranus as a traditional ruler in user-facing text.
Do not frame disruption as automatically liberating.
Do not predict divorce, job loss, relocation, or crisis from Uranus cycle alone.
weighting: Exact Uranus-to-Uranus contact is stronger than age estimate.
Angular Uranus or contacts to Sun, Moon, Ascendant, MC, Venus, Mars, or chart ruler increase relevance.
Repeated testimony from returns, progressions, profections, or transits is required before naming concrete events.
Use as modern lens context behind the scenes unless the app exposes modern life-cycle views.
